description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka Act, entering item "6. Department of English Language  Teaching" that Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 896/2 of 07.11.1995
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to a university schedule under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory authority (Section 27(1)) to modify the academic structure of Rajarata University by adding a new department. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing regulations rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
